description_en: Queries the certificates of accelerated domain names
description_zh: 调用DescribeCdnCertificateList按照域名查询证书列表信息
name: DescribeCdnCertificateList

parameters.help_en:
The accelerated domain name. Separate multiple accelerated domain names with commas (,).

If you do not specify an accelerated domain name, SSL certificates of all your accelerated domain names are queried
parameters.help_zh:
加速域名，多个域名用英文逗号（,）分隔。

如果不传入该参数，默认查询所有加速域名
parameters.name: domain_name
